role: The ONE art-side statement of the museum twin family: which files in patent-portfolio/ have a twin in ~/projects/awkronos/patents, what the relationship between the copies is, and the measured pins that hold that statement. Prose elsewhere (DEBT-museum-navigation-duplication.md, module headers, commit messages) points here and does not restate numbers.

law.one_ssot: Numbers live in this file and are produced by tests/unit/twin-measure.mjs from two trees. A second copy of a pin is a fork, and this family has already been caught with one that rotted.
law.union_not_revert: Divergent content is recorded with a digest, never silently deleted, and never reverted to whichever copy scored better. A pair whose two sides each hold unique lines is declared diverged and left alone.
law.similarity_never_authorizes_consolidatio: SimHash/hamming scores classify; they do not prove identity and they do not license a merge or a deletion. Only sha256 over the declared recipe pins bytes. A code_map_rsi_targets rankScore is band order, not a measured quantity.
law.byte_identity_is_recipe_scoped: 'Identical' always names the recipe it was measured under — doc-header, comment-header or whole — because every pair in this family that looks identical as a body is different as a whole file, by header design.

basis.art_pin_channel: blob + sha256 of the tree bytes, per pair row. No art commit sha is recorded: the register is committed INTO the commit its own HEAD value would name, so that value could only ever be stale — and the art side does not need it, because R2 re-measures these bytes against the checkout on every run. Cite the ref in a commit message or the lane envelope, never here.

geometry_agreement.why: navigation.js reads DIMENSIONS from ./architecture.js. These are its keys, measured in both copies of architecture.js, so 'port navigation whole' is a checked claim and not a re-argument of DEBT residual text.
geometry_agreement.note: read_by_navigation is the set the tripwire re-derives from navigation.js's own source on every run; debt_port_checklist is what the DEBT note asks a port lane to verify; diverged_unread is recorded with both values because it is a real divergence the pair's own file cannot be broken by — declared, not consolidated, and not this lane's to merge.
